notes.design_authority: docs/us_short_system_design.md §4.2 (催化剂 = 规则映射分(非分位); 仅已实现/当前, 未来事件归 §8.1) + §13.1 #14 打分标准化口径
notes.prior_status: v1 locked defaults; every point value + bucket bound is a §13.1 #14 FORWARD prior, NOT validated alpha and NOT ship-gate evidence. Forward-calibration is a REVIEWED schema+preset+module version bump, never a silent edit, so the catalyst mapping cannot drift/weaken without review.
notes.realized_only: the block scores REALIZED/current signals ONLY; a future-dated signal is EXCLUDED and belongs to §8.1 forward_events (engine/us_short_forward_events.py), never the selection score. The engine enforces this exclusion against each signal's caller-supplied event_date vs the run as_of; the PROVENANCE that those dates are real/PIT is the provider/live data layer (gated, see data_layer_gated).
notes.scope_boundary: fundamental beat/miss (earnings actual vs expected) + analyst revisions + filed 8-K event class + advisory LLM semantic ONLY. The good-data-BAD-price-REACTION soft penalty is the SEPARATE engine/us_short_risk_downgrade.py (core_score = ... − risk_downgrade; §18.1 #26 两字段分离), NOT folded into this block.
notes.data_layer_gated: the real FMP earnings/analyst + free SEC 8-K EXTRACTION that produces these per-ticker signals is the provider/live data layer, separately gated (SR-PROVIDER-001). This engine is the pure offline rule-mapping over INJECTED signals (mirrors the momentum slice, whose Massive grouped-daily data layer is likewise gated).
